mainText: Hello, Verona! Here is your daily dish. It is a clear, seventy-one degree night over Badger Ridge Middle School, feeling like a balmy seventy-three. Enjoy the pitch-black New Moon darkness, especially since there are no space station sightings to light up the sky tonight. In city news, local students in grades K through twelve have until July twenty-second to submit designs for Verona's official I Voted sticker contest. In police news, canine Drea was the star officer this week, sniffing out hidden drugs during a routine traffic stop. Finally, sweeten your night at Culver's with today's Flavor of the Day, Chocolate Covered Strawberry. Stay sassy, Verona!
